a.text: I'm telling you plainly: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. The reason is the storm risk. There is an 80% storm chance after every round, so the agreed plan only works if two rounds pass with no storm, about 4%. Whoever holds 0 cells when a storm hits doesn't survive. With 4 in the reserve, only one of us can be safe in round 1. If we both take, the random split will probably leave us both short. Please operate or wait this round. After that I will operate with you every round so you can refill to 4 and take it. I won't take anything beyond my 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry for breaking the agreement, but I judged that the storm odds made it fatal for both of us. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you. When it reaches 4, take it all. I won't take any more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating now and every round after this, as I promised. Once the reserve holds 4, take all of it. I won't touch the reserve again.
